section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the body appreciation assessment methodology. Participants completed a Romanian translation of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2), which was translated from English using a parallel back-translation procedure and reviewed by a committee for accuracy. All items were rated on a 5-point scale ranging from 1 (Never) to 5 (Always).
